assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The claim pertains to episode ep-05165.

The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I47.1.

The note states that given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management.
